title: elsholtzia splendens var. hallasanensis
intro: Elsholtzia splendens var. hallasanensis, commonly known as Seokbaeksan, is a type of plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae) that is native to Korea. It has been traditionally used in Korean medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Seokbaeksan include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation, protecting against oxidative stress, and inhibiting the growth of microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of Seokbaeksan include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
